name: HazardNet
description: Multi-Hazard Early Warning AI agent for Bangladesh agriculture. Publishes 7- and 15-day outlooks for 8 climate hazards (flood, flash flood, tropical cyclone, drought, heat wave, cold wave, fire, severe local storm) across 64 districts with dual-track severity scoring, independent physics cross-checks, and full provenance for every number.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Firebase ID token (JWT) for authenticated endpoints. Obtain via Firebase Auth sign-in.

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-API-Key
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Pre-shared API key for server-to-server write endpoints (forecast ingest, push broadcast). Contact contact@hazardnet.live.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: No authentication required for public read endpoints (forecasts, alerts, weather, historical, predictions, conversions).

skills.name: Multi-Hazard Forecast
skills.description: Retrieve 7- and 15-day hazard outlooks for Bangladesh's 64 districts across 8 hazard classes (flood, flash flood, tropical cyclone, drought, heat wave, cold wave, fire, severe local storm). Each forecast includes hazard class, severity index (0-1), confidence bin, and independent physics cross-check with full provenance.
examples: What is the flood outlook for Dhaka district for the next 7 days?
Show me all hazard forecasts for Rangpur division
Which districts have cyclone warnings this fortnight?

skills.name: Weather Observations
skills.description: Fetch current weather observations (temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, radiation, evapotranspiration) for any latitude/longitude in Bangladesh from Open-Meteo.
examples: What is the current weather at coordinates 23.8103, 90.4125?

skills.name: Hazard Alert Monitoring
skills.description: Monitor published hazard alerts with their evidence, drivers, policy version, and review status. Alerts carry their own provenance including the drivers behind the level and whether a duty officer reviewed them.
examples: Show me all active flood alerts
Are there any cyclone warnings for coastal districts?

skills.name: Historical Hazard Catalog
skills.description: Query the historical climatic hazard catalog for Bangladesh, covering past events across all eight hazard classes with episode data.
examples: Show me the historical flood events for Kurigram district
What drought events have been recorded in Rajshahi?

skills.name: AI Advisory Chat
skills.description: Conversational AI advisory for Bangladesh hazard assessment. Ask natural-language questions about hazards, forecasts, districts, and severity — receive grounded responses with references to committed artifacts. Requires Firebase authentication for higher rate limits.
examples: What should farmers in Bogra do given the current flood outlook?
Explain the severity score of 0.85 for heat wave in Jessore
Compare the model severity track with the physics track for flood in Sunamganj

skills.name: Hazard Unit Conversions
skills.description: Convert between measurement units relevant to hazard assessment including temperature (Celsius/Fahrenheit/Kelvin), precipitation (mm/inches), wind speed (km/h/mph/knots/m/s), and pressure (hPa/inHg/mmHg).
